requirements.text: Continuous three-lane operation while the owner is away ('keep the loops running nonstop all 3 build build build'): the orchestrator keeps all three supervised build lanes cycling without waiting for owner replies - monitor the loops, harvest each unit at its close, commit/cherry-pick/push, submit at CI-green heads, dispatch independent review waves, accept at seams under the standard v2 flow, and re-feed every finished lane with the next released packet (full contract drill per D-077-R002) and relaunch its loop. Ordinary Tier A actions (ADR-006) proceed autonomously overnight.
requirements.required_harness: The session record shows lanes re-fed at seams without owner round-trips: harvests, submits, waves, accepts, contract seams, and relaunches recorded in the ledger/git/CI while the owner is away.
requirements.required_evidence: Ledger progress entries, seam commits, gate records, and loop journals across the unattended window.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; in force for the current unattended window.

requirements.text: 'Nonstop' lifts NO stop condition: Tier D / Section 20 hard stops, owner holds (expansion section 2 minus the D-040/D-076 scoped releases; the PR #241 hold), gate FAIL handling, genuine blockers, the dependency-security policy, and D-072 loop isolation all stand unchanged. When a lane hits a stop condition, park THAT lane (blocker or queued owner item) and keep the other lanes building; never bypass, waive, or reinterpret a stop to keep a lane moving.
requirements.required_harness: Any stop condition hit overnight appears as a blocker/queued item with the lane parked, never as bypassed or silently continued work.
requirements.required_evidence: Blocker records / queued owner items for any stop condition encountered; absence of waivers.

requirements.text: Sequencing boundary: lanes are re-fed ONLY from the released, non-held queue under existing directives (D-077-R003 unchanged; D-078 pair order per D-078-R003; B3-UI contracts after M5-T057 accepts per the phased plan). The D-076-R003 owner-review checkpoint after phase B3 is a NAMED owner checkpoint: if reached overnight it WAITS for the owner - 'build build build' does not substitute for that review; phase C does not start.
requirements.required_harness: Every overnight contract seam cites its released-queue source; no phase-C packet exists before the owner walkthrough.
requirements.required_evidence: Contract-seam commits + packet directive_refs across the unattended window.
